metadata.title: Privacy policy
metadata.description: GDPR / AVG summary for Orechdin — controller, DPO, rights, retention; link to the official privacy page.

PrivacyPage.headline: Privacy statement
PrivacyPage.intro: This page summarises how the firm describes the processing of personal data under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR / AVG). It reflects the published statement (version dated 24/05/2018). For the authoritative wording on the live site, see the
PrivacyPage.controllerBody1: Law firm Nir Zeltzer - Orechdin (ORECHDIN) is the data controller. ORECHDIN is a civil company (private limited liability form), registered under KBO number {kbo}, {court}, with its registered office at {street}, {postal} {city}.
PrivacyPage.controllerBody2: The data protection officer is {name}, reachable at the same address, by email
PrivacyPage.processedBody: The firm states that it processes personal data because you use its legal services and/or because you provide data yourself. Examples given include: name; gender; date and place of birth; address; telephone and email; bank account; company and VAT numbers; documents required under anti-money laundering rules; application forms; and, where relevant, special categories such as criminal data or data of persons under 16 (only with consent, guardian involvement, or necessity to protect minors' rights).
PrivacyPage.purposesBody: Processing is described as limited to what is necessary for professional obligations — for example: legal advice and other requested services; handling information requests; legal compliance; client communication; billing; and applications. Legal bases under Article 6(1) GDPR mentioned include consent, contract performance, legal obligation, vital interests, and legitimate interests in the context of legal practice.
PrivacyPage.retentionBody: Personal data are retained for the period required by law — the public statement refers, where applicable, to retention up to five years after termination of the client agreement. Data are shared with third parties only when necessary for legal obligations or the agreement (courts, bailiffs, notaries, other lawyers, accountants, etc.) or with processors under appropriate measures. Transfers outside the EEA are limited to what the statement describes for international filings.
PrivacyPage.rightsBody1: You may exercise rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, objection, and withdrawal of consent where applicable. Requests may be sent to ORECHDIN via
PrivacyPage.rightsBody2: . You may lodge a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority.
PrivacyPage.marketingBody: Given professional secrecy, the firm states that it does not process clients' personal data for direct marketing in the manner described on the official statement.
PrivacyPage.supportNote: This summary supports orientation only. It does not replace the full legal text published by the firm.

NeoCaseFile.panelSubtitle: OVB-aligned · every fact carries a source pointer
NeoCaseFile.panelFooter: This file is built from your own messages. Nothing is shared with the office until you press Submit.
NeoCaseFile.emptyIntro: As you and NEO chat, the panel on the right fills in with what an Antwerp lawyer would want to see — parties, chronology, the legal issue, supporting documents, and a conflict gate. Everything carries a source pointer back to your own words.
NeoCaseFile.emptyWarning: Nothing is shared with the office until you press Submit.
NeoCaseFile.cryptoSafetyText: This session is secured with TLS 1.3 End-to-End Encryption. Case data processing strictly adheres to the EU GDPR minimization principles and the EU AI Act (Art. 13) transparency requirements.
NeoCaseFile.riskEmpty: No automatic risk signal raised. Lawyer must still run a formal conflict check.
NeoCaseFile.caseTheory: Case theory (NITA framework — intake hypothesis only)
NeoCaseFile.evidenceEmpty: Drop documents into the chat — they show up here, indexed.
NeoCaseFile.proceduralEmpty: No deadlines or procedural events extracted yet.
NeoCaseFile.exportDesc: The brief is generated server-side as a real PDF or Word document — same artefact the office receives. The layout follows the OVB Behandeling-dossier indeling so the lawyer can drop it straight into a matter folder.
NeoCaseFile.notSentNote: Nothing reaches the office until you press Send brief.
NeoCaseFile.disabledNote: Downloads are for your own records — sending to the office is currently disabled in this environment.
NeoCaseFile.deliverDesc: Select a channel below. Your case file — including the full dossier, timeline, and evidence index — will be composed and opened in your chosen app. You can review before sending.
NeoCaseFile.deliverFooter: The full PDF and Word documents can be downloaded separately using the buttons above. The text delivered via these channels is a summary; attach the PDF for the complete record.
NeoCaseFile.deliveredSuccess: Case file delivered! The office will review your submission.
